summary: Verified storefront-per-company flag-OFF scoping fix. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed against LIVE prod (SAFE MODE) — KLOSE (company_id=62) returns storefront_pending shell with account_handle='hostbay', primary_company_id=1, has_handle=false on stats/analytics, and PUT profile is rejected with 400 'doesn't have its own storefront yet'; hostbay (id=1) regressions all intact (no storefront_pending, has_handle=true, no X-Company-Id header defaults to hostbay). Frontend: Playwright confirmed under KLOSE the storefront-pending card renders on Page/Products/Share tabs with correct KLOSE + @hostbay text, storefront-company-hint ('Editing KLOSE's storefront') visible, storefront-open-page action ABSENT, dashboard claim-handle-banner ABSENT. Clicking storefront-pending-switch-btn switches to hostbay, creator-status-banner appears with 'Your creator page is live', and Share tab shows the hostbay URL. Zero console errors. Ended session with hostbay selected (last_company_id=1) as required.

issues: Banner text is 'Your creator page is live' — spec wording said 'Your page is live'. Semantic match; not a bug, just wording nuance to note.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correctly scoped: pending shell is returned by /creator/profile, /creator/stats, /creator/analytics for non-primary companies when STOREFRONT_PER_COMPANY=false, and PUT is blocked at controller before any DB write — no data leak from primary company (hostbay).
Frontend gates on all three storefront tabs + dashboard claim banner are consistent with backend has_handle/storefront_pending signals via useStorefrontProfile.
seed_data_creation: None — SAFE MODE, no writes performed (PUT under X-Company-Id:62 was rejected by backend as expected; company switch only updated tbl_user.last_company_id and was restored to 1=hostbay at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login path is /auth/login (2-step). To scope requests to a specific company without UI switching, set localStorage 'last_company_id' before navigation; axios interceptor forwards it as X-Company-Id. Login endpoint is POST /api/user/login returning data.accessToken. STOREFRONT_PER_COMPANY=false in backend/.env is intentional — do not toggle.
